name: Business Reviews – build trust with real customer feedback
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Show visitors real customer reviews from Google, Facebook, and Yelp – social proof that turns browsers into buyers, right on your WordPress site.

Business Reviews | Documentation | Pricing | Support | Demo

Why Business Reviews?

New customers trust other customers. Business Reviews collects and showcases authentic feedback from Google My Business, Facebook Pages, and Yelp directly on your WordPress website – so the reputation you’ve earned works for you on every page.

Reviews are presented in a visually appealing, responsive layout that fits seamlessly with your site’s design and branding. Whether you run a restaurant, online store, or local business, displaying verified reviews builds trust, boosts credibility, and encourages new customers to engage with your services.

With flexible display options, customizable design settings, and simple account integration, Business Reviews makes managing and displaying your latest reviews effortless.

Free Features

  • Multi-platform support: Display reviews from Google My Business, Facebook Page, and Yelp all in one place.
  • Customizable display: Choose which platforms and reviews to show and how they appear on your website.
  • Flexible layout controls: Adjust the number of columns, column gaps, and row gaps for the perfect grid.
  • Design customization: Control wrapper background, padding, and border radius; card background, hover shadow, and borders; and image padding, border, and background.
  • Text and color options: Adjust colors for reviewer names, timestamps, rating icons, and review text, with hover effects.
  • Element visibility: Show or hide reviewer image, name, time, rating, and review description.
  • Responsive and lightweight: Works across all devices and WordPress themes without slowing down your site.

Pro Version

Upgrade to Business Reviews Pro for advanced layouts, extended review visibility, and typography control.

Pro features include:

  • Unlimited Facebook reviews: Display all available reviews from your connected Facebook Page without limitations.
  • Multiple layout styles: Choose from Grid 1–4, Masonry, and Slider layouts for a more dynamic display.
  • Toast notifications: Floating “toast” messages that highlight reviews, with control over position, duration, and animation.
  • Advanced typography controls: Customize fonts for reviewer name, date, review text, and author details.
  • Review text limit: Set character limits for long reviews to keep a clean, organized look.
  • Improved performance and styling: More control over spacing, shadows, and hover effects.

Try the Pro Version – Unlock all premium features today!

How to Use

  1. Install and activate the Business Reviews plugin.
  2. Open the page or post where you want to display reviews, click the + icon in the Gutenberg editor, and search for Business Reviews.
  3. Add the Business Reviews block to your page.
  4. Connect your Facebook, Google, and Yelp accounts, then customize the layout and design from the settings panel on the right.
  5. Publish or update the page – your customer reviews are now live!

Business Reviews fully supports the block editor: add the block, choose a layout, and preview live reviews directly inside the editor. A shortcode is also available to place reviews anywhere.

Live Demo | Upgrade to Pro

Use Cases

  • Local Businesses: Show your Google My Business rating and reviews to nearby customers.
  • Restaurants & Cafes: Display Yelp feedback where hungry visitors can see it.
  • Online Stores: Add social proof next to products and checkout pages.
  • Service Providers: Combine Facebook, Google, and Yelp reviews on one trust-building page.

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Business Review”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Add the Business Reviews block to any post or page in the Gutenberg editor.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the plugin zip file from WordPress.org.
  2. Upload the business-review.zip contents to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Why are only 5 Google reviews showing?

By default the Google Places API returns only 5 reviews, which is why you cannot see more than 5.

Why are only 3 Yelp reviews showing?

By default the Yelp API returns only 3 reviews, which is why you cannot see more than 3.

Can I show more Facebook reviews?

Yes. The Pro version displays all available reviews from your connected Facebook Page without limitations.

Is Business Reviews free?

Yes, Business Reviews is a free Gutenberg block plugin. A Pro version adds extra layouts, unlimited Facebook reviews, toast notifications, and typography controls.

How do I connect Google, Facebook, and Yelp?

Add the Business Reviews block, then connect your accounts from the block settings. Guides for generating your Google API key, Place ID, and Yelp credentials are in the documentation.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it will work with any standard WordPress theme.

Can I change block settings?

Yes, you can change block settings from the Gutenberg block editor’s right sidebar.

How many times can I reuse the block?

You can use the block an unlimited number of times.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here
